description: The engine's guide: "overview" (the tools), "html" (paper, headers/footers, page numbers, tables of contents, footnotes, fonts, images, accessibility), "pages" (page kinds, breaks and keeping together, covers, numbering, bleed and crop marks), "design" (columns, drop caps, page decorations and watermarks, spacing, images and text wrap, typography), "charts" (the chart block), "codes" (QR codes and barcodes), "forms" (fillable fields), "templates" (the template language).
